5.4.0.title: Router setup + aos-router
5.4.0.how: Pick which agent does which role (default, claude-only, budget); inspect it any time.

5.4.0.title: AOS Control mod
5.4.0.how: Claude Code pane for gate, fleet and sessions; it loads with the bdb-aos-control plugin.

5.4.0.title: Fabric pipelines
5.4.0.how: The pipelines are now /fabric (picks the mode), /fabric-graph, /fabric-multigraph and /fabric-teamwork. Define custom roles and teams for a run.

5.4.0.title: go-gate setting
5.4.0.how: Settings has a go-gate row with modes hard, soft and off; update never re-enables a gate you turned off.

5.4.0.title: Duplicate agents fixed
5.4.0.how: Loose copies of plugin agents in ~/.claude/agents are retired on update; edited ones are kept and reported.

5.4.0.title: Embed allowlist for AO 2.0
5.4.0.how: The AO dashboard may now be embedded by allow-listed origins only.

5.4.0.title: clear-context skill
5.4.0.how: Save a verified handoff before /clear or a context limit, then resume from it.

5.4.0.title: Context profiles
5.4.0.how: Lower start-of-session tokens with full, orchestrator, worker or small.

5.4.0.title: aos allow
5.4.0.how: Add permission rules for blocked remote or aos commands; you run it, agents never do.
